title: MARKENFARBEN
slide_intent: Explain the role of each color so designers can use repetition and contrast intentionally.
strategic_value: A consistent red accent with neutral grounds and expressive Lilac can sustain DB recognition without requiring large red fields.
demonstration: The introduction assigns identity to DB Red, expressive warmth to Lilac and focused backgrounds to White and Cold Black.
practical_value: Choose color by its job rather than by how much area it can fill.

content_islands.name: Color-role statement
content_islands.spec: Place the uppercase title above the paragraph describing each color’s role and the value of consistent use.

reference_purposes.Intent: The prose explicitly says recognition comes from consistency, not quantity, and explains each color’s job.

ingredient.name: Brand palette roles
ingredient.role: Separate recognition, expression and visual support.
ingredient.application: Use DB Red as the identifying accent, Lilac for expressive emphasis and White/Cold Black for calm grounds.
ingredient.scope: This introductory role statement supplies no numerical area proportions; detailed use constraints follow elsewhere in the guide.
